verdict.rationale: SolidJS's official docs explicitly market Resources as a way to treat server data as reactive state with Suspense enabling responsive loading UI (solid-gh-3, solid-gh-11, solid-gh-4). However, a detailed hands-on community critique directly contradicts this, warning to 'avoid Suspense... which can be very slow with no workaround' (solid-comm-15), a concrete counter-example rather than general skepticism. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks or docs addressing/resolving the reported Suspense performance issue, and additional hands-on confirmation that resource+suspense loading UX works well in practice.
